overview_description.description:
ZeroStorefront consists of an all-in-one platform that connects point-of-sale, delivery platforms, reviews sites, chat, phone, and other applications. It illuminates the customer path, provides attribution for customer behavior, and provide the tools necessary to safely share customer data across applications.

Founded in 2019, ZeroStorefront is a proud YCombinator alum, and a diverse, venture-backed, high-growth company. Its customers include brands like Frank Pepe’s, Halal Guys, and more.

product.name: Automated SMS Text Message Marketing
product.description: Enables restaurants to drive traffic and sales through automated text messaging, using templates for various customer engagement scenarios.

product.name: Mobile Messaging for Customer Communication
product.description: Allows restaurants to communicate with customers directly through mobile messaging, offering a high engagement channel.

product.name: Review Monitoring and Management
product.description: Collects and analyzes customer reviews from multiple platforms, enabling restaurants to respond and manage their online reputation.

product.name: Data Integration and Management
product.description: Connects restaurant data sources for unified management, supporting over 200 integrations for comprehensive data unification.

product.name: Marketing ROI Measurement
product.description: Provides tools for restaurants to measure the profitability of marketing campaigns, not just by revenue but by actual profit.

product.name: Customer Data Capture
product.description: Captures customer data from every marketing channel, helping restaurants to lower marketing costs and engage their customer base effectively.
